question: 过去30天哪个地区的销售额下降最明显？请与之前30天比较。

oracle.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_date FROM orders), region_revenue AS (SELECT c.region, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN a.max_date - INTERVAL '29 days' AND a.max_date THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS current_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN a.max_date - INTERVAL '59 days' AND a.max_date - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS previous_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN a.max_date - INTERVAL '59 days' AND a.max_date GROUP BY c.region) SELECT region, current_revenue, previous_revenue, ROUND(100 * (current_revenue - previous_revenue) / NULLIF(previous_revenue, 0), 2) AS revenue_change_pct FROM region_revenue ORDER BY revenue_change_pct ASC LIMIT 1

question: 最近45天电子产品退款率是否异常？请与其他品类比较。

oracle.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_date FROM orders) SELECT p.category, COUNT(r.id) AS refunded_items, COUNT(oi.id) AS total_items, ROUND(COUNT(r.id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(oi.id), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN a.max_date - INTERVAL '44 days' AND a.max_date GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY refund_rate DESC

question: Paid Search 最近30天广告投入是否带来了匹配的访问和销售增长？

oracle.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT LEAST((SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM orders), (SELECT MAX(event_date) FROM daily_traffic)) AS max_date), periods AS (SELECT 'recent_30_days' AS period_name, max_date - INTERVAL '29 days' AS start_date, max_date AS end_date FROM anchor UNION ALL SELECT 'previous_30_days', max_date - INTERVAL '59 days', max_date - INTERVAL '30 days' FROM anchor), traffic AS (SELECT p.period_name, ROUND(SUM(d.ad_spend), 2) AS ad_spend, SUM(d.visits) AS visits FROM periods p JOIN daily_traffic d ON d.event_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date AND d.channel = 'Paid Search' GROUP BY p.period_name), revenue AS (SELECT p.period_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM periods p JOIN orders o ON o.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date AND o.channel = 'Paid Search' JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY p.period_name) SELECT p.period_name, t.ad_spend, t.visits, r.revenue FROM periods p JOIN traffic t ON t.period_name = p.period_name JOIN revenue r ON r.period_name = p.period_name ORDER BY p.start_date DESC

question: 按渠道比较最近90天收入，并指出贡献最高和最低的渠道。

oracle.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_date FROM orders) SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN a.max_date - INTERVAL '89 days' AND a.max_date GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: 退款最常见的三个原因是什么，各自涉及多少退款金额？

oracle.sql: SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS refund_count, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS refund_amount FROM refunds GROUP BY reason ORDER BY refund_count DESC, refund_amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: 比较最近60天各产品品类的收入，并指出最高和最低的品类。

oracle.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_date FROM orders) SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN a.max_date - INTERVAL '59 days' AND a.max_date GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: 最近30天访问量最高和最低的渠道分别是什么？请给出访问量。

oracle.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(event_date) AS max_date FROM daily_traffic) SELECT channel, SUM(visits) AS visits FROM daily_traffic d CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE d.event_date BETWEEN a.max_date - INTERVAL '29 days' AND a.max_date GROUP BY channel ORDER BY visits DESC

question: Marketplace 最近30天广告花费与之前30天相比变化了多少？

oracle.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(event_date) AS max_date FROM daily_traffic), periods AS (SELECT 'recent_30_days' AS period_name, max_date - INTERVAL '29 days' AS start_date, max_date AS end_date FROM anchor UNION ALL SELECT 'previous_30_days', max_date - INTERVAL '59 days', max_date - INTERVAL '30 days' FROM anchor) SELECT p.period_name, ROUND(SUM(d.ad_spend), 2) AS ad_spend FROM periods p JOIN daily_traffic d ON d.event_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date AND d.channel = 'Marketplace' GROUP BY p.period_name, p.start_date ORDER BY p.start_date DESC

question: 最近90天销量最高的三个商品是什么？请给出销售件数。

oracle.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_date FROM orders) SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN a.max_date - INTERVAL '89 days' AND a.max_date GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, product_name LIMIT 3

question: 最近90天哪个渠道的订单取消率最高？

oracle.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_date FROM orders) SELECT o.channel, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_orders, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'cancelled')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders o CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN a.max_date - INTERVAL '89 days' AND a.max_date GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY cancellation_rate DESC, channel LIMIT 1

question: 最近90天哪个产品品类的退款金额最高？请给出金额。

oracle.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(refund_date) AS max_date FROM refunds) SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(r.amount), 2) AS refund_amount FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = r.order_item_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE r.refund_date BETWEEN a.max_date - INTERVAL '89 days' AND a.max_date GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY refund_amount DESC LIMIT 1

question: 最近90天各渠道平均客单价是多少？指出最高和最低渠道。

oracle.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_date FROM orders) SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0), 2) AS average_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN a.max_date - INTERVAL '89 days' AND a.max_date GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY average_order_value DESC

question: 最近90天哪个产品品类的平均折扣最高？

oracle.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_date FROM orders) SELECT p.category, ROUND(AVG(oi.discount), 4) AS average_discount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN a.max_date - INTERVAL '89 days' AND a.max_date GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY average_discount DESC, category LIMIT 1

question: 最近90天按产品品类比较毛利润，并指出最高和最低的品类。

oracle.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_date FROM orders) SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost - COALESCE(r.amount, 0)), 2) AS gross_profit FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN a.max_date - INTERVAL '89 days' AND a.max_date GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gross_profit DESC

question: 最近30天订单量最多和最少的地区分别是什么？请给出订单数。

oracle.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_date FROM orders) SELECT c.region, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN a.max_date - INTERVAL '29 days' AND a.max_date GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY order_count DESC
